headline: Record profitability and growth as guidance moves higher
summary_short: Revenue rose 25% y/y to $850.5M as non-GAAP operating margin hit a record 23% and free cash flow grew 14% to $136.0M, even as the GAAP operating loss widened to $29.6M on stock-based comp and acquisition costs.
summary_long: Revenue grew 25% y/y to $850.5M, driven by $102.7M of expansion revenue from existing customers plus 17% customer-base growth. ARR reached $3,525M (+25% y/y), including a $127M contribution from the Red Canary acquisition; excluding Red Canary, ARR grew 21%. Opex rose across S&M (+18%), R&D (+37%) and G&A (+32%) on headcount and stock-based comp, widening the GAAP operating loss to $29.6M, but non-GAAP operating margin hit a record 23% (+1ppt y/y) and free cash flow grew 14% to $136.0M. Cash plus short-term investments totaled $3.5B after a $770.0M cash acquisition. Zscaler raised Q4 and full-year FY2026 revenue, ARR, and non-GAAP operating income/EPS guidance, while lowering full-year free-cash-flow-margin guidance on higher capex.

drivers.explanation: Growth driven primarily by $102.7M of additional revenue from existing-customer expansion, plus new-customer additions that grew the customer base 17% y/y.
Widened as R&D (+37%), S&M (+18%) and G&A (+32%) all grew faster than gross profit, largely on higher stock-based comp and headcount-related costs.
Reached a record 23% as non-GAAP opex growth trailed 25% revenue growth once stock-based comp, acquisition costs and intangible amortization are excluded.
Grew 25% y/y to $3,525M, including a $127M contribution from the Red Canary acquisition; ex-Red Canary organic ARR growth was 21%.
Grew 14% to $136.0M as operating cash flow held near prior-year levels while capex (property/equipment plus capitalized software) declined y/y.

CFO cited 'record profitability' with non-GAAP operating margin at an all-time high; company raised Q4 and full-year revenue, ARR and non-GAAP profitability guidance, while lowering FY2026 free-cash-flow-margin guidance to reflect higher planned capex.
